descriptionChirho: To speak abusively or insultingly against someone, casting blame or shame upon them through hostile speech.
To hurl defiance at an opponent or at God, especially in a military or confrontational context, expressing contemptuous challenge.
To treat with contempt and disdain, regarding someone or something as worthless or beneath consideration.
To sharply correct or reprove someone, causing shame through authoritative censure rather than hostile mockery.
